inputs.style: Metallica-inspired, Stomping extremely heavy groove metal, huge dry snare and kick, thick downtuned distorted guitars, tight bass, snarling forceful low male voice, savage blues-inflected guitar solo. 112 BPM, D minor. an enormous staggered low riff with deliberate silences; dominant bass, crushing chorus and threatening half-time bridge. Groove Metal, D Minor, Heavy. English male vocals, raw heavy metal studio performance. Complete 280-330 second song. Qwen form: Riff Intro & V 0-115s; Chorus & V2 115-220s; Bridge & Solo 220-270s; Final Chorus 270-300s. Heavy guitar riff intro under 8 seconds, verses, choruses, solo, final heavy cadence. Use constant M:4/4, L:1/16, Q:1/4=112, explicit bars, no repeat marks, no tempo changes.
inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
Dust on the velvet, cold on the stone
I took the weight that no man has known
The ledger’s thick with the names of the dead
Every year I rule is a promise unpaid

[Chorus]
Crown of debts, heavy on my skull
Choking on the gold, choking on the full
Crown of debts, I can’t pay it back
The throne is a grave and the dark is thick

[Verse]
The jewels are eyes of the servants below
Watching me from the hall, watching me go
I wear their patience, I wear their pain
A king made of rust and a crown of rain

[Chorus]
Crown of debts, heavy on my skull
Choking on the gold, choking on the full
Crown of debts, I can’t pay it back
The throne is a grave and the dark is thick

[Bridge]
Hold the silence, let the riff drop deep
The hammer falls, while the kings sleep
One final strike on the iron gate
The debt is collected, the soul is late

[Solo]

[Chorus]
Crown of debts, heavy on my skull
Choking on the gold, choking on the full
Crown of debts, I can’t pay it back
The throne is a grave and the dark is thick

[Outro]
The debt is paid
The stone stays cold
No more gold
